'''''Predator''''' was a modified [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ship]] owned by [[Khlor]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] active during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. The [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter's [[Khlor's hideout|hideout]] resided on a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Velusia/Legends|Velusia]]. Khlor's prefabricated [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] featured a vehicle bay. Still, when the bounty hunter was hiding on his island, he landed ''Predator'' in a gully in the northern portion of his hideout, concealing it with [[Camouflage net|camo netting]].<ref name="Core" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Predator'' was mentioned in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a [[2003]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Core" />
